name: givt-sandbox
description: GIVT — Gamified, Individualized, Verified Talent. Full-stack educational workforce platform.

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run server:dev"
scripts.setup: npm install --include=dev && cd server && npm install
scripts.dev:bootstrap: npm run setup && npm run migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
